items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: that was the last band I played in. Piku had a piece there

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more about that band I mentioned before that you played in the Piku. Oh. And Milton, Mr. Milton was telling us about just two days ago.
Well, that was, that was the last band I played in. Piku had a piece there, it was called Get Busy Right. Get Busy Right.
Get Busy Right. Yeah. Just went something like that.
